topic: Is Selunara free to use as the product name of a Windows desktop AI coding assistant (formerly MoonAliza/Moonzila; Selenic was refused for a Parasoft trademark): US, EU and WIPO marks for Selunara and close variants; software and AI products and companies named Selunara; GitHub, npm and PyPI names; selunara domains; Microsoft Store listings; the word's meaning
notes: Run 2 (5 pages, about 5 credits; doctor balance 311 after run 1, from 326 at the start, so this is the last of the 20-credit budget). Run 1 left four things open: Justia lists SELUNA marks of Seluna Ltd for computer software relating to the medical field (serials 99332277, a word mark, and 99337404, a design mark), whose status and classes only the USPTO record shows; Google's page 2 answered with its request-verification page; the GitHub user search lists an account selunara-id that nothing else explains; and selunara.ai failed on a Firecrawl proxy error. The other Justia hits are not followed to TSDR, for budget: Seluna Therapeutics' pharmaceutical SELUNA (98563112), Seluna LLC's supplement SELUNA (50040549), SELUNARIA for textiles (99346043) and the 2009 SALUNA-style sportswear mark (77799904) are all for goods far from software, so their status cannot move the verdict under the scale in research/DISCOVERY.md. Not collected, for budget and because the kit keeps no capture of an error page: the RDAP records of selunara.dev, .app and .io, which a planning curl found answering 404 (U-11 stays KNOWN-UNKNOWN with the day-one step).
